title: A new perspective on non-commutative deformations of field and gauge theories
summary: We construct non-commutative deformations of field and gauge theories based on star-products implemented by Drinfel'd twists. We are able to encompass a large family of twists, including those built out of conformal symmetries and supersymmetries. The main idea behind our construction is to work with twists constructed from symmetries of the undeformed theory, that are realised as active symmetry transformations.
